text: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.
arabic: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ أَنْفَعُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ

text: The Most Merciful shows mercy to those who are merciful. Be merciful to those on the earth, and the One in the heavens will have mercy upon you.
arabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ

text: A true Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.
arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ

text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

text: The strong person is not the one who overcomes people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.
arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ

text: A good and pleasant word is an act of charity.
arabic: الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ

text: He who does not thank people is not grateful to Allah.
arabic: مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ لَا يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ

text: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not repel people.
arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا

text: Indeed, Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ، وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ

text: Wondrous is the affair of the believer, for there is good for him in every matter: if prosperity comes to him he is grateful, and if adversity strikes him he is patient.
arabic: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ

text: Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good deed to erase it, and treat people with good character.
arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ

text: Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
arabic: مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمْ لَا يُرْحَمْ

text: The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those that are most consistent, even if they are small.
arabic: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ

text: Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him before you.
arabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ

text: Part of the perfection of a person’s Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.
arabic: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ

text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ

text: And Allah is in the aid of His servant as long as the servant is in the aid of his brother.
arabic: وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ

text: Whoever takes a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.
arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ

text: Look at those who have less than you, and do not look at those who have more than you, so that you do not belittle the blessings of Allah upon you.
arabic: انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ، وَلَا تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ، فَهُوَ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ لَا تَزْدَرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ

text: Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, do not turn away from one another, and be brothers, O servants of Allah.
arabic: لَا تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلَا تَبَاغَضُوا، وَلَا تَدَابَرُوا، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا

text: Gentleness is not in anything except that it adorns it, and it is not removed from anything except that it mars it.
arabic: إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لَا يَكُونُ فِي شَيْءٍ إِلَّا زَانَهُ، وَلَا يُنْزَعُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا شَانَهُ

text: If you were to rely upon Allah with true reliance, He would provide for you just as He provides for the birds: they go out hungry in the morning and return full in the evening.
arabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرُزِقْتُمْ كَمَا يُرْزَقُ الطَّيْرُ

text: No one has been given a gift better and more comprehensive than patience.
arabic: وَمَا أُعْطِيَ أَحَدٌ عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ

text: Charity does not decrease wealth, and Allah increases a servant who forgives only in honor.
arabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلَّا عِزًّا

text: The most complete of the believers in faith are those with the best character.
arabic: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا

text: Supplication (Dua) is the very essence of worship.
arabic: الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ

text: Purity is half of faith, and saying Alhamdulillah fills the scale of good deeds.
arabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الْإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلَأُ الْمِيزَانَ

text: Removing a harmful obstacle from the road is an act of charity.
arabic: إِزَالَةُ الْأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ صَدَقَةٌ

text: Guard strictly against three traits: speaking falsehood, breaking promises, and betraying trust.
arabic: آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلَاثٌ: إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ، وَإِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ

text: Allah Almighty says: I am as My servant expects of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me.
arabic: يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي

text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ

text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbor.
arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلَا يُؤْذِ جَارَهُ

text: In serving every living creature there is a reward.
arabic: فِي كُلِّ كَبِدٍ رَطْبَةٍ أَجْرٌ

text: Spread peace (greetings of Salam) among yourselves.
arabic: أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ بَيْنَكُمْ

text: No fatigue, illness, anxiety, or sorrow befalls a believer except that Allah expiates some of his sins thereby.
arabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلَا وَصَبٍ وَلَا هَمٍّ وَلَا حُزْنٍ إِلَّا كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ

text: There are two blessings which many people lose out on: good health and free time.
arabic: نِعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ: الصِّحَّةُ وَالْفَرَاغُ

text: Hold fast to truthfulness, for truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.
arabic: عَلَيْكُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ، فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ

text: The one who strives to help the widow and the poor is like the one who strives in the cause of Allah.
arabic: السَّاعِي عَلَى الْأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ

text: Richness is not having many possessions; rather, true richness is the richness and contentment of the soul.
arabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ

text: Whoever conceals the faults of a fellow believer, Allah will conceal his faults in this world and the Hereafter.
arabic: مَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ

text: Give glad tidings to those who walk to the mosques in darkness of complete light on the Day of Resurrection.
arabic: بَشِّرِ الْمَشَّائِينَ فِي الظُّلَمِ إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ بِالنُّورِ التَّامِّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ

text: Whoever among you wakes up secure in his home, healthy in his body, and has provisions for his day, it is as if the whole world has been gathered for him.
arabic: مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمْ آمِنًا فِي سِرْبِهِ، مُعَافًى فِي جَسَدِهِ، عِنْدَهُ قُوتُ يَوْمِهِ، فَكَأَنَّمَا حِيزَتْ لَهُ الدُّنْيَا

text: The upper (giving) hand is better than the lower (receiving) hand.
arabic: الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى

text: True patience is at the very first stroke of a calamity.
arabic: إِنَّمَا الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الْأُولَى

text: The likeness of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not is that of the living and the dead.
arabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ

text: There is no Muslim who plants a tree or sows a crop from which a bird, person, or animal eats, except that it counts as charity for him.
arabic: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا أَوْ يَزْرَعُ زَرْعًا فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ طَيْرٌ أَوْ إِنْسَانٌ أَوْ بَهِيمَةٌ إِلَّا كَانَ لَهُ بِهِ صَدَقَةٌ

text: Fulfill the trust for the one who entrusted you, and do not betray the one who betrayed you.
arabic: أَدِّ الْأَمَانَةَ إِلَى مَنِ ائْتَمَنَكَ، وَلَا تَخُنْ مَنْ خَانَكَ

text: Exchange gifts with one another and you will love one another.
arabic: تَهَادَوْا تَحَابُّوا

text: Every son of Adam makes mistakes, and the best of those who make mistakes are those who repent.
arabic: كُلُّ ابْنِ آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ، وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ

text: Two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil Adheem.
arabic: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

text: Allah does not burden any soul beyond its capacity.
arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا

text: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ

text: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are true believers.
arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

text: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely upon Him.
arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ

text: Say: Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

text: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.
arabic: لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا

text: Unquestionably, for the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
arabic: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

text: And my success is not but through Allah. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.
arabic: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ

text: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah.
arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ

text: Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow the reward of the doers of good to be lost.
arabic: إِنَّهُ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

text: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer — We will surely cause him to live a good life.
arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً

text: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ

text: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment.
arabic: وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا

text: And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers.
arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

text: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا

text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds — the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا

text: My Lord, expand for me my breast with assurance, and ease for me my task.
arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي

text: Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
arabic: لَا تَخَافَا إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ

text: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

text: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

text: And say: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

text: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
arabic: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ

text: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them harshly, they say words of peace.
arabic: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا

text: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.
arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

text: No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me.
arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ

text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.
arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ

text: Is He not best who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil?
arabic: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ

text: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ

text: And those who strive for Us — We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
arabic: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

text: And be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, that is of the matters requiring determination.
arabic: وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَكَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ

text: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance.
arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا

text: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy — none can withhold it.
arabic: مَّا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا

text: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.
arabic: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

text: And I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of His servants.
arabic: وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ

text: And your Lord says: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.
arabic: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ

text: Repel evil by that which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity will become as though he were a devoted friend.
arabic: ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ

text: Allah is Subtle and Kind with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
arabic: اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ

text: But whoever pardons and makes reconciliation — his reward is due from Allah.
arabic: فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ

text: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their present faith.
arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِيمَانًا مَّعَ إِيمَانِهِمْ

text: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
arabic: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

text: Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.
arabic: إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ

text: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ

text: Indeed, it is Allah who is the continual Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ

text: And be patient for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes.
arabic: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا

text: And that there is not for man except that good for which he strives, and that his effort is going to be seen.
arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ ۝ وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ

text: Is the reward for good anything but good?
arabic: هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ

text: And whoever believes in Allah — He will guide his heart.
arabic: وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ

text: And whoever fears Allah — He will make for him a way out.
arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا

text: Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.
arabic: سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا

text: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ

title: Prophet Adam and the First Prayer of Repentance
text: When Adam and Hawwa ate from the forbidden tree, instead of making excuses, they immediately turned to Allah saying: "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." Allah accepted their sincere repentance.

title: Prophet Nuh and 950 Years of Steadfast Patience
text: Prophet Nuh remained among his people for nine hundred and fifty years, calling them night and day, privately and publicly, to the worship of One God. Despite relentless mockery, his perseverance never wavered.

title: Building the Ark of Nuh on Dry Land
text: Commanded by Allah, Prophet Nuh began building a massive ark on dry land far from any sea. Mocked by passersby, he worked with unwavering trust in Allah’s promise until the flood came and the ark became the vessel of salvation.

title: Prophet Idris: The Prophet of Truth and Knowledge
text: Prophet Idris dedicated his life to truth, worship, and teaching humanity knowledge and writing. Honored in the Quran as a man of pure truth (Siddiq), Allah raised him to a lofty station.

title: Prophet Hud Against the Arrogance of 'Ad
text: The people of 'Ad boasted of their physical strength and lofty pillars, asking, "Who is mightier than us?" Prophet Hud gently reminded them that Allah, who created them, is far mightier, and that true strength lies in humility and gratitude.

title: Prophet Salih and Respecting the Rights of Creation
text: When Allah sent the miraculous she-camel as a sign to Thamud, Prophet Salih fairly divided the water shares between the people and the animal, warning them not to harm her—teaching that kindness toward creation is a test of faith.

title: Prophet Ibrahim’s Search for Truth Under the Stars
text: To awaken his people’s intellect, Prophet Ibrahim pointed to a star, the moon, and the sun. As each set, he declared: "I do not love things that vanish. Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth."

title: The Fire Becoming Cool and Safe for Prophet Ibrahim
text: Cast into a blazing fire, Prophet Ibrahim said with complete serenity: "Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs." Immediately Allah commanded: "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim!"

title: Prophet Ibrahim’s Gentle Courtesy in Dialogue
text: Despite harsh opposition and threats of exile, Prophet Ibrahim addressed his elder with the tenderest respect ("O my dear father") and replied to hostility with peace: "Peace be upon you; I will ask my Lord to forgive you."

title: Hajar’s Trust in Allah and the Spring of Zamzam
text: Left in the barren valley of Makkah with infant Isma'il, Hajar asked Prophet Ibrahim: "Did Allah command you to do this?" When he answered yes, she said with certainty: "Then He will never abandon us." Soon after, the blessed spring of Zamzam gushed forth.

title: The Submission and Patience of Prophet Isma'il
text: When Prophet Ibrahim shared the divine test with his son Isma'il, the youth replied with serene devotion: "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."

title: Raising the Kaaba and the Sincere Prayer of Acceptance
text: As Prophets Ibrahim and Isma'il raised the foundations of the Kaaba, they did not boast of their great deed, but humbly prayed: "Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing."

title: The Generous Hospitality of Prophet Ibrahim
text: When unknown guests arrived at Prophet Ibrahim’s home, he greeted them warmly and hastened quietly to prepare a generous meal for them—establishing noble hospitality as a prophetic tradition.

title: Glad Tidings of Prophet Ishaq in Old Age
text: The angels brought glad tidings of the birth of Ishaq and Ya'qub to Ibrahim and Sarah in their advanced age. When Sarah marveled, they said: "Do you wonder at the decree of Allah?" Nothing is impossible for God.

title: The Beautiful Patience of Prophet Ya'qub
text: Confronted with the loss of his beloved son Yusuf, Prophet Ya'qub declared: "Beautiful patience is most fitting, and Allah is the One sought for help." Beautiful patience combines inner composure with unwavering hope in God.

title: Prophet Yusuf: From the Bottom of the Well to Honor
text: Thrown into a dark well as a child, sold into servitude, and imprisoned unjustly for years, Prophet Yusuf preserved his integrity and faith until Allah elevated him to leadership over Egypt.

title: Prophet Yusuf’s Chastity and Refuge in Allah
text: When all doors were locked and temptation surrounded him, Prophet Yusuf sought refuge in God: "I seek refuge in Allah! Truly He is my Lord who has made my stay honorable." Remembering God’s blessings shields the heart.

title: Prophet Yusuf’s Kindness Inside the Prison
text: Even behind prison walls, Prophet Yusuf comforted his fellow inmates and guided them kindly, prompting them to testify: "Indeed, we see you to be of the doers of good."

title: Prophet Yusuf’s Noble Forgiveness of His Brothers
text: When his brothers stood humbled before him at the height of his power, Prophet Yusuf did not reproach them, saying instead: "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allah forgive you; and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful."

title: Prophet Ayyub’s Patience and Courtesy in Illness
text: Tested for years with severe illness and loss, Prophet Ayyub never complained. When he called upon his Lord with gentle courtesy, Allah restored his health and multiplied his blessings, praising him: "Indeed, We found him patient—an excellent servant!"

title: Prophet Shu'ayb and Honesty in Trade and Measure
text: Prophet Shu'ayb eloquently called the people of Madyan to worship Allah and uphold strict honesty in commerce: "Give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive people of their due."

title: The Cradle of Infant Musa Upon the River Nile
text: Inspired by Allah to place her newborn in a basket upon the Nile to save him from Pharaoh’s soldiers, Musa’s mother trusted God’s promise: "We will return him to you." The very waves carried him safely back to his mother’s arms.

title: Prophet Musa’s Chivalry at the Well of Madyan
text: Arriving exhausted and alone at the well of Madyan, Prophet Musa noticed two women waiting modestly away from the crowd. He stepped forward chivalrously to water their flock without asking anything in return, then sat in the shade praising and supplicating Allah.

title: The Command to Speak Gently Even to Pharaoh
text: When sending Prophets Musa and Harun to Pharaoh, Allah instructed them: "And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear Allah"—teaching that calling others to truth requires gentleness.

title: The Parting of the Sea Through Musa’s Unshakeable Faith
text: Trapped between the sea ahead and Pharaoh’s army behind, the people cried out that they were overtaken. Prophet Musa answered firmly: "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me"—and at once the sea parted into a path of deliverance.

title: Musa’s Journey with Al-Khidr: Hidden Wisdom Behind Events
text: In Prophet Musa’s journey with the righteous servant Al-Khidr, events that seemed distressing on the surface—such as damaging a poor family’s boat—actually saved it from a tyrant king, revealing the hidden mercy behind divine decrees.

title: Prophet Harun: The Messenger of Eloquence and Unity
text: Prophet Harun stood side by side with his brother Musa through every trial with eloquence and compassion, exemplifying the noblest bond of brotherhood and mutual support in the service of truth.

title: Prophet Dawud’s Victory Through Faith Over Jalut
text: Facing the mighty army of Jalut, the steadfast believers declared: "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah!" Prophet Dawud defeated Jalut, and Allah granted him wisdom and just sovereignty.

title: The Mountains and Birds Glorifying Allah with Prophet Dawud
text: Despite being a great king, Prophet Dawud ate from the labor of his own hands and glorified Allah morning and evening with such heartfelt devotion that the mountains and birds echoed his praise.

title: The Just Judgment of Prophets Dawud and Sulayman
text: In a dispute over a damaged field, young Sulayman proposed a restorative solution that rehabilitated the farmer’s land while preserving the shepherd’s flock—and Allah praised both Dawud and Sulayman for their wisdom and justice.

title: Prophet Sulayman’s Smile and Gratitude in the Valley of Ants
text: Hearing a tiny ant warn its colony to enter their dwellings lest the army crush them unknowingly, Prophet Sulayman smiled, protected the ants, and prayed: "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor."

title: Sulayman’s View of Wealth: "This Is to Test Whether I Am Grateful"
text: Beholding the throne of Sheba brought before him in the blink of an eye, Prophet Sulayman immediately humbled himself: "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful."

title: The Queen of Sheba Embracing Faith Through Wisdom
text: Rather than using force, Prophet Sulayman invited the Queen of Sheba with a noble letter beginning "In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful," guiding her through wisdom until she willingly embraced faith in the Lord of the worlds.

title: Prophet Ilyas and His Unwavering Call to Monotheism
text: Prophet Ilyas stood bravely among his people, calling them away from idols toward the worship of Allah, the Best of Creators. Allah immortalized his noble legacy across generations: "Peace be upon Ilyasin."

title: Prophet Al-Yasa' Among the Chosen Righteous
text: Continuing the mission of guidance, patience, and service to people after Ilyas, Prophet Al-Yasa' is praised in the Quran among the chosen and truly righteous.

title: Prophet Dhul-Kifl: Honoring Covenants with Patience
text: Renowned for fulfilling every pledge and judging with unwavering patience and fairness, Prophet Dhul-Kifl is honored in the Quran alongside Isma'il and Idris among the steadfast.

title: Prophet Yunus’s Glorification in the Three Darknesses
text: Enveloped in the darkness of night, the deep sea, and the belly of the whale, Prophet Yunus called out: "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers." Allah rescued him and promised: "And thus do We save the believers."

title: The Repentance of the People of Yunus and Divine Mercy
text: When the people of Yunus saw the signs of impending punishment, the entire city turned to Allah in sincere repentance and faith—and Allah lifted the punishment from over a hundred thousand souls.

title: Prophet Zakariyya’s Whispered Prayer of Hope
text: Though frail with old age and white hair, Prophet Zakariyya called upon his Lord in a gentle whisper: "And I have never been, in my supplication to You, my Lord, unblessed." Allah answered him with the birth of Yahya.

title: Prophet Yahya: Wisdom from Childhood and Kindness to Parents
text: Allah granted Prophet Yahya wisdom even in childhood, along with tender compassion, purity, and devotion to his parents—never arrogant or disobedient.

title: Maryam’s Purity and Trust Beneath the Palm Tree
text: In her moment of solitude and pain at the birth of 'Isa, a reassuring call reached Maryam: "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you fresh, ripe dates."

title: Prophet 'Isa Speaking from the Cradle
text: Pointing to her newborn infant in defense of her honor, Maryam watched as baby 'Isa spoke miraculously from the cradle: "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet, and He has made me blessed wherever I am."

title: The Healing Miracles of Prophet 'Isa by Allah’s Permission
text: Prophet 'Isa healed those born blind and the afflicted, yet every single time he humbly emphasized that it was done solely "by the permission of Allah"—directing all hearts toward the Creator.

title: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: The Trustworthy (Al-Amin) Before Prophethood
text: Long before revelation, the people of Makkah knew Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as "As-Sadiq Al-Amin" (The Truthful, The Trustworthy), and his wise arbitration in placing the Black Stone prevented tribal bloodshed.

title: The First Revelation in the Cave of Hira: "Read in the Name of Your Lord"
text: The very first word revealed to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in the Cave of Hira was a call to knowledge and literacy: "Read in the name of your Lord who created—Who taught by the pen—taught man that which he knew not."

title: The Prophet’s Prayer of Mercy for the People of Ta'if
text: Even after being pelted with stones in Ta'if, Prophet Muhammad ﷺ refused to call down punishment upon them, saying instead with boundless mercy: "Rather, I hope that Allah will bring forth from their descendants people who will worship Allah alone."

title: Tranquility in the Cave of Thawr: "Indeed, Allah Is with Us"
text: During the Hijrah, when pursuers stood directly outside the Cave of Thawr, the Prophet ﷺ reassured his companion with serene certainty: "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us"—and Allah sent down His tranquility upon him.

title: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah: A Clear Victory Through Peace
text: At Hudaybiyyah, the Prophet ﷺ chose a peaceful treaty over conflict. In the resulting atmosphere of peace, hearts opened freely to the message of the Quran, and Allah named that treaty "a clear victory" in Surah Al-Fath.

title: The Universal Pardon on the Day of the Conquest of Makkah
text: On the day Makkah opened peacefully, the Prophet ﷺ stood before those who had persecuted him for twenty years and proclaimed universal forgiveness: "No blame upon you today; go, for you are all free!"

title: The Sublime Character of the Final Messenger ﷺ
text: Allah praised His final Messenger ﷺ saying: "And indeed, you are of a great moral character." He greeted children first, visited the sick, served his family with his own hands, and was sent as a mercy to all the worlds.
